(2) A sharp 'ding' SFX punctuates the end of the chant as the speakers shout 'Yeah' with high vocal arousal. (3) Continuous female narration starts; the speech rate is rapid and the tone is highly enthusiastic. Minimal fabric rustle is audible. (4) A cinematic 'whoosh' SFX triggers a transition to the next visual phase while the upbeat music maintains a steady BPM. (5) A bubbly 'pop' SFX accompanies the appearance of on-screen shopping text, following the rhythmic pattern of the BGM. (6) The sound of a fitting room door latch clicking is heard, followed immediately by a rise in vocal pitch and laughter as the women reveal new outfits. (7) A comedic, cartoon-like melodic hum is performed vocally by one speaker, momentarily dominating the mix with a playful, teasing tone. (8) A final 'whoosh' SFX leads into the high-intensity promotional call-to-action, where the speaker's volume and projection increase over the swelling synth music. (9) The audio ends abruptly with a hard cut and a short, energetic vocal sign-off.
